newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK41 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK41 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 41 million kuna in 91-day treasury bills at a primary auction.
The rate fell 50 basis points to 10.45 percent from late in April when this maturity was last sold. Price rose to 97.461 from 97.343 percent. Full results are on page MFHT.
The issued volume fell short of the 50 million kuna target although bids totalled 54 million. Non-banking investors bought a meagre 2.44 percent.
This brought the outstanding short-term government debt to 541 million kuna, the ministry said.
It set the next auction for June 17, when it will offer 40 million kuna in 182-day T-bills. They were last issued at 11.25 percent on May 20. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
